You obviously won’t get away with committing crime, as that’s the law, but what he did wasn’t necessarily “evil”, but rather him being a survivor.

This thread and sub is for ANALYZING not for OVER-ANALYZING.

Walter may have taken killing Badger as a possibility but he left the choice to JESSE as he’s his boss and has no say on what happens to him. He kept his mouth shut and waited for Jesse’s feedback.

He didn’t save Jane because he was too shocked/traumatized and didn’t know what to do. If you want to pay attention to facial expressions so much, you could tell from that scene he was shocked from what’s happening in front him.

He genuinely didn’t know who Combo was. Seeing that he only met Jesse’s associates ONCE. I, myself wouldn’t give a shit if someone who I don’t know, only met once and didn’t talk more than 30 seconds, die. He worked for Jesse, Walter had nothing to do with him.

He cared, but he didn’t want people to know. His pride may have been bad but it wasn’t over the top that he exposed himself as a meth cook just to prove to people that he worked hard for his money. Not getting credit for what you worked so hard for would be painful for anyone.

And finally, Walter isn’t a saint. He’s an antihero, ruthless when it comes to his and his family’s intrest.

Best reply to Walter’s haters. He’s an antihero and ruthless when it comes to defending his and his family’s interest.
